description:
crate-jmap-mail-server/src has 10 production sites using `serde_json::from_value(v.clone())` where `v: &serde_json::Value`. The clone copies the entire JSON subtree; for non-trivial filter/sort args this is wasted work.

Sites:
- snippet.rs:46, 57
- submission.rs:156, 762
- sieve.rs:175, 183
- email.rs:1366, 1479, 1494, 1502

The `Deserialize::deserialize(v)` path (with `v: &Value`) does not require an owned input — `&Value` implements Deserializer. This avoids the tree clone entirely.

Pattern: change `serde_json::from_value(v.clone())` → `<TargetType>::deserialize(v)` (or `serde::Deserialize::deserialize(v)` with type ascription).

Why P3: allocation pattern, not correctness. Each request typically clones a small filter/sort tree once. Cost is bounded by request arg size.

Cookie-cutter coordination: jmap-mail-server is the canonical extension-server template per workspace AGENTS.md; this change should propagate to all extension-server sibling crates (chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing) wherever the same pattern appears (or land in the canonical first if it originated in a sibling).
notes:
Fixed in commit 7de21b1.

Production sites swept (13 total):
- jmap-mail-server/src/email.rs: 5 sites (1372, 1477, 1485, 1500, 1508)
- jmap-mail-server/src/sieve.rs: 2 sites (177, 185)
- jmap-mail-server/src/snippet.rs: 2 sites (46, 57)
- jmap-mail-server/src/submission.rs: 3 sites (156, 574, 792)
- jmap-tasks-server/src/task.rs: 1 site (45) — bonus production hit not listed in original bead

Pattern: serde_json::from_value(v.clone()) → T::deserialize(v) (with serde::Deserialize imported per file). For Vec<X> / HashMap<K,V> targets where the type is inferred from let binding, written as Vec::<X>::deserialize(v) etc. for clarity at the call site.

Out of scope (not fixed):
- jmap-calendars-server/src/lib.rs:372,383 — both inside #[cfg(test)] mod test_support (mock backend used by inline tests). Test-only code is not in the bead's production-clone scope. If desired, file a separate trivial cleanup bead.

Gate: cargo build --workspace, cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace all green.
title: P3: 10 from_value(v.clone()) sites in mail-server clone subtrees unnecessarily
